work_item: BB-CONTEXT same-case JSON table filter/sort/select/project explanation consumer and local-file recovery
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: An actual committed JSON string-table operation -> ordinary same-case ExplainPrevious -> exact sealed input and report revalidation -> bounded source-span explanation -> Core render/history and local-file recovery without resend

implementation.store: Loads the exact prior InputBundle using actor/case/input/version and verifies its request identity, raw-text digest, meaning signature, parser-bound fingerprint and sealed request fields.
implementation.document_consumer: Identifies only the four JSON string-table report schemas in scope, requires the matching sealed JsonTable* intent, recomputes from that exact intent document and parameters, checks report dependency/canonical bytes/pretty text, then validates and displays bounded source byte ranges and their hashes.
implementation.core_route: The normal ExplainPrevious route links prior result -> sealed input bundle -> typed report in its required artifact graph and result dependencies.
implementation.recovery_route: Reconstructs the same exact explanation and dependencies before observing the already-written, originally authorized local file; no effect is resent.

normal_cli_route.observed: Each real CLI producer returned COMMIT/COMPUTED with a stored report. A subsequent same-case 詳しく説明して returned COMMIT with dependencies [prior result ID, exact original input-bundle SHA-256, report-artifact SHA-256], original byte-range disclosure, matching context_result_ref and retained final result.

recovery_route.simulated_edge: Retain the actual Core Adopted record after render and physical local write, remove later receipt revisions, then reopen the Store and run the ordinary reconciliation verifier.
recovery_route.observed: The exact sealed input, recomputed report, explanation units and three dependencies matched. Recovery returned COMMIT/CONFIRMED with the original idempotency key; target bytes and modification time were unchanged.

full_workspace_runtime_tests: NOT_RUN; this BODY-1 unit ran the store retrieval test, ordinary CLI producer/consumer route and recovery replay test only.
limitations: Only JSON string-table filter, sort, select and project results are consumed by this unit.
Joins, comparisons, group operations, other document transforms and general language acceptance are outside this route.
The recovery route verifies one local-file crash edge and one filter operation; all four operations are covered through the normal CLI route.
No full B04, A07, A14 or E08 acceptance claim is made.
